build.title: Henry's small ramp
build.summary: Source-constrained reconstruction candidate. Read the independent evidence before building.

stages.title: Join the five-piece wedge
stages.instruction: Hold the red rear square and attach the two yellow sides. At 00:24.5 the three-piece U stands on the table. Add the two orange driving squares along the sloped edges; the proposed deck order and grips are checked separately.

stages.title: Make the launch module on its side
stages.instruction: Place the red back square flat on the table. Hold the red roof upright at its far edge, then attach both green sides. The 31-second source view shows assembly in progress; the 32.5-second view shows all four panels attached. Henry turns this completed module before joining it to the ramp; that transfer needs its own motion check.

constructionEvidence.claim: Final back panel lies on the table while the final roof is held upright.
The completed launch rotates before joining the wedge; this transfer is not yet validated.

stages.title: Connect the launch to the wedge
stages.instruction: Bring the launch roof's front edge to the wedge's high edge. Seat both magnets before releasing; do not press through an unresolved gap.

instructions.title: Join the five-piece wedge
instructions.instruction: Hold the red rear square and attach the two yellow sides. At 00:24.5 the three-piece U stands on the table. Add the two orange driving squares along the sloped edges; the proposed deck order and grips are checked separately. New parts: P1 (Isosceles triangle), P2 (Isosceles triangle), P3 (Small square), P4 (Small square), P5 (Small square). Joins present after assembly checks: P2 edge 2 to P3 edge 3; P1 edge 2 to P3 edge 1; P3 edge 2 to P4 edge 4; P2 edge 2 to P4 edge 3; P1 edge 2 to P4 edge 1; P4 edge 2 to P5 edge 2; P2 edge 1 to P5 edge 3; P1 edge 1 to P5 edge 1. Source frame: small-fit. Release checkpoint: consult the measured result before following this candidate.

instructions.title: Make the launch module on its side
instructions.instruction: Place the red back square flat on the table. Hold the red roof upright at its far edge, then attach both green sides. The 31-second source view shows assembly in progress; the 32.5-second view shows all four panels attached. Henry turns this completed module before joining it to the ramp; that transfer needs its own motion check. New parts: P6 (Small square), P7 (Small square), P8 (Right triangle), P9 (Right triangle). Joins present after assembly checks: P6 edge 2 to P7 edge 2; P7 edge 1 to P8 edge 3; P6 edge 1 to P8 edge 1; P7 edge 3 to P9 edge 3; P6 edge 3 to P9 edge 1. Source frame: small-construction-seat-32.5. Keep this module in your hand; no unattended release is asserted.

instructions.title: Connect the launch to the wedge
instructions.instruction: Bring the launch roof's front edge to the wedge's high edge. Seat both magnets before releasing; do not press through an unresolved gap. Reuse the numbered parts already assembled. Joins present after assembly checks: P5 edge 2 to P6 edge 4; P4 edge 2 to P6 edge 4. Source frame: small-check. Release checkpoint: consult the measured result before following this candidate.
